notes: physical_total_gb is the honest MemTotal on this box (see research/headless-probe-2026-08-19.md); nominal 128 is NOT advertised as allocatable.
os_kernel/runtime/controller reserves are measured floors at idle; MEM_FLOOR_GB=24 in app.py is the same 24.0 safety floor.
display_service_gb=0.0 because the Spark is headless (graphical-session.target dead, no Xorg/Wayland). If a desktop were enabled this rises ~5-8 GiB and must be added to reserves before any plan.
allocatable_pool_gb = physical_total_gb - sum(reserves) = 121.7 - 52.0 = 69.7 GiB on this headless config.
kv_cache_transients_note: KV/context growth is charged per-active-LLM from its manifest's kv_phase; the fixed 9.0 GiB here reserves steady-state cache/transients not attributable to a specific model.
